title: The alphabet
examples: Teacher, what sound does the letter B make?
Can you show me the letter that comes after G?
What word starts with the letter T?

explain.say: Today we learn the letters of the alphabet. We say the names and the sounds.

draw.text: A to Z: Names and Sounds

explain.say: Let us start with the letter A. It says /a/ like in apple.
Next is the letter B. It makes a /b/ sound like in ball.
The letter C says /k/ like in cat. Can you say /k/?
We continue to D. D makes a /d/ sound like in dog. Good job.
Now for the letter E. E says /e/ like in egg. Listen to the sound.

faq.q: What is the difference between the letter name and the letter sound?
faq.a: The letter name is what you say when you say the letter, like 'A'. The sound is the noise the letter makes, like /a/.
asks: How do I say the letter?
What sound does the letter make?

faq.q: Do I learn all the letters at once?
faq.a: No, we learn them slowly. We learn a few letters each week or day.
asks: Is it okay to learn some letters first?
How long will it take to learn them all?

faq.q: What if I forget a sound?
faq.a: That is okay. Just try to remember it by looking at a picture that starts with that sound.
asks: What should I do if I forget?

faq.q: Are the sounds the same in all English books?
faq.a: Most books use the standard sounds we are learning. Sometimes there are little differences.
asks: Is the sound always the same?

faq.a: The alphabet is the set of letters we use to write words.
asks: Can you show me the alphabet?

faq.q: What is the difference between the letter name and the letter sound?
faq.a: The letter name is what you say when you say the letter, like 'A'. The sound is the noise the letter makes, like /a/.
asks: How do I say the letter?
What sound does the letter make?

facts: The English alphabet has twenty six letters.
Each letter has a name and a sound.
The letters are arranged in a specific order.
Learning the sounds helps you read words.

quiz.say: What sound does the letter M make?
quiz.why: The letter M makes the /m/ sound, like in moon.

wrong.1: This sound is for the letter N, not M.
wrong.2: You should say the single sound, not repeat it.
wrong.3: This is the letter name, not the sound.

quiz.say: If a word starts with the sound /t/, which letter is it?
quiz.why: The letter T makes the /t/ sound, like in top.
